meta.name: stock-analysis
meta.description: 股票个股分析，实时获取价格涨跌幅，计算技术指标和支撑位，识别缺口并判断支撑压力，智能预测未来3天走势并给出操作建议

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析个股走势，预测未来3天行情并给出操作建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析股票并获取买卖参考
copy.tagline_en: Analyze individual stocks, predict next 3 days trend and give trading suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick stock analysis and trading suggestions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能对指定股票进行技术分析：获取实时行情、计算均线/MACD/RSI等指标、识别支撑压力位和缺口，并预测未来3天走势，给出操作建议。
howto.when: 当用户提供股票代码（如000001、sh600000、AAPL）并要求分析走势、预测未来或获取操作建议时触发。

say.note: Claude 会获取数据并生成技术分析报告。
Claude 会综合技术指标给出概率评估。
Claude 会识别缺口并分析其支撑压力作用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform technical analysis on specified stocks: fetch real-time data, calculate indicators (MA, MACD, RSI), identify support/resistance levels and gaps, predict the next 3 days' trend, and give trading suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a stock code (e.g., 000001, sh600000, AAPL) and asks for trend analysis, future prediction, or trading advice.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch data and generate a technical analysis report.
Claude will give probability assessment based on indicators.
Claude will identify gaps and analyze their support/resistance roles.
